title: Clicking Constellation Cuttlefish
statement: Drifting beneath sunken basalt arches and glowing sea-ferns, this velvet-mantled cephalopod spends its days meticulously arranging smooth shards of tumbled sea-glass into intricate, ever-changing geometric patterns on the sandy floor. Whenever a visitor leans close, it hovers at the glass with a soft, rhythmic clicking, rippling golden, star-like speckles across its midnight-blue skin as if eagerly translating its thoughts into miniature galaxies.
